title: Cyanobacteria Total Lipid Extraction from Cell Pellets
author: Robbie Martin
materials: Prepare the three separate solutions needed for this extraction protocol as listed below. lipid extraction solvent (step 2) with a 1:1 ratio of butanol and lab purified water (water-saturated butanol, and lab purified water Butanol Fischer Scientific Catalog #71-36-3

Prepare the three separate solutions needed for this extraction protocol as follows: lipid extraction solvent: a 15 : 15 : 5 : 1 : 0.18 ratio by volume of 95% ethanol, water, diethyl ether, pyridine, and 4.2 N ammonium hydroxide, respectively. water-saturated butanol: a 1:1 ratio of butanol and Milli-Q water purified lab water: (Milli-Q water)

steps.title: Concentrate cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture (10–25 mL lab culture of Microcystis aeruginosa or ~50 mL raw lake/mesocosm sample) at appropriate speed, decant supernatant, transfer the pellet to a 2‑mL centrifuge tube; re‑pellet if needed to remove residual supernatant.

steps.title: Add solvent and glass beads
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL extraction solvent and ~100 µL glass beads to the pellet, vortex for ~5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 60 °C water bath for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a 1‑dram glass vial (vial #1); the first two extractions will be combined in this vial.

steps.title: Second extraction without beads
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2–4 (add 1 mL solvent, vortex 5 s, incubate 60 °C 20 min, centrifuge 10,000 × g 10 min) but omit glass beads; add the resulting supernatant to vial #1.

steps.title: Dry combined extracts
steps.instruction: Dry the contents of dram vial #1 under a stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: Re‑suspend in butanol/water
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL water‑saturated butanol and 150 µL Milli‑Q water to the dried residue, vortex, transfer the mixture to a 2‑mL centrifuge tube, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Collect top butanol phase
steps.instruction: Remove the upper butanol layer and place it into a new 1‑dram glass vial (vial #2).

steps.title: Wash original vial with butanol
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL saturated butanol to dram vial #1, vortex, transfer the wash to the residual aqueous phase in the 2‑mL tube from step 8, vortex, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 2 minutes, then collect the top butanol layer and add it to vial #2.

steps.title: Dry final butanol extract
steps.instruction: Dry the combined butanol phases in dram vial #2 under a stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: Re‑suspend for LC/MS
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried residue in 300 µL of 9:1 methanol:chloroform.

steps.title: Proceed to LC/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Samples are now ready for LC/MS analysis.
